verdict.what_is_wrong: A localized runnable-CPU starvation episode affected PID 18786 (`VM Periodic Tas`) in one container. CPU throttling is the leading explanation because the process had long ready-to-run waits while most CPUs were idle, but the quota signature is not confirmed: the measured 100 ms CPU ceiling was irregular, and the observed rhythm repeated at 300 ms. Treat this as suspected, not proven, CPU throttling.
